literal_meaning: ঠেকা (থামা বা আটকে পড়া) এবং বেঠেকা (বসে পড়া বা অস্থায়ী বসবাস)
figurative_meaning_en: Temporary or makeshift arrangements due to scarcity, lack, or complaints causing hindrances
example_sentences_in_bangla: অভাবের কারণে আমরা ঠেকা-বেঠেকায় কাজ চালাই।
example_sentences_in_english: Poor families get by with makeshift arrangements day to day.
Due to scarcity, we manage our work in a temporary, haphazard way.
note: This idiom reflects the socio-economic realities of Bengali life, often used to describe improvised living conditions.
